name: site/section-header
title: SectionHeader
summary: The eyebrow, serif heading and lead cluster at the top of a marketing section, with the heading level and its visual size set separately.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short label above the heading (`.eyebrow`).

props.name: title
props.description: The heading text. Rich headings use the `title` slot instead (or as well: the slot follows the text).

props.name: description
props.description: The lead paragraph. Rich leads use the `description` slot.

props.name: align
props.description: `center` centres the block and its text (`mx-auto text-center`) and the eyebrow (`justify-center`).

props.name: as
props.description: The heading level, for the document outline.

props.name: size
props.description: The heading's visual size (`text-display`, `text-h1`…); defaults to match `as`.

slots.name: description
slots.description: A rich lead, rendered after the `description` text. Either one makes the lead paragraph render.

slots.name: title
slots.description: A rich heading, rendered after the `title` text inside the heading.

behaviour:
Renders a
holding the eyebrow

(only with `eyebrow`), the heading at level `as` (always), and the lead

(only with `description` or the `description` slot).
The heading's class is `font-serif <size> text-foreground text-balance`, the size following `size` or else `as`.
The block's class is `max`, then `mx-auto text-center` when centred, then `class`.

centered.description: A centred page title at display size, with a tinted eyebrow and a wider block.

rich.description: Heading and lead from the slots, at h3.

bare.description: A title only: no eyebrow, no lead.

keyboard: None of its own; links in the slots are reached in order.
aria: No aria: the heading level (`as`) carries the structure, decoupled from its visual size.

theming.brandOverlay: Nothing of its own; an `eyebrowClass` such as `text-primary` follows the overlay.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The block is capped at `max` (max-w-2xl by default); the heading balances its lines and the lead is pretty-wrapped. The type-scale utilities step the sizes per breakpoint.
contract:
contract
  slot is "section-header"
  class is "max-w-2xl"
  when centered class is "max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center mb-12"
  when default shows h2 "Tools for builders"
  when default shows p "What we do"
  when default shows p "Everything you need to ship."
  when centered shows h1 "Simple pricing"
  when rich shows h3 "Open by default"
  when rich shows p "charter"
  when bare shows h2 "Our partners"
end

checks.say: The heading defaults to an h2 at text-h2.
The visual size is decoupled from the level.
A centred eyebrow is centred and tinted.
The rich heading renders its markup.
The rich lead renders its markup.

gaps: The `.eyebrow` and type-scale utilities (`text-display`, `text-h1`…, `text-body`) live in each consuming site's globals.css; the registry does not ship them.
`max`, `eyebrowClass` and `class` take raw Tailwind classes, so a caller can name a mineral or a colour value the brand overlay does not govern (the source comment suggests `text-gold`).
